Title: Double booking allowed on identical facility time slot under concurrency
Description: Concurrent requests for the same court slot both resulted in CONFIRMED status
Precondition: Active venue with at least one facility court
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Send two simultaneous POST requests for same facility slot 18:00
Expected: One booking CONFIRMED and second rejected with 409 conflict
Suggested Fix: Pessimistic write locking on facility + conflict exception handling

Title: Organization creation permitted without strict auth token check
Description: Unauthenticated POST to /createOrganization creates record with fallback user ID 1
Actual: HTTP 400 Bad Request (Authentication context missing: X-User-Id header is required)
Suggested Fix: Enforce strict non-null X-User-Id and X-User-Uuid in organization controllers
